title: Pro-China officials, online trolls embolden Beijing to make daring acts

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Philippine officials and alleged online trolls who defend China could be giving Beijing more confidence to make daring acts and statements amid the escalating tensions in the West Philippine Sea, Defense Secretary Gilbert “Gibo” Teodoro warned on Monday. During Monday’s hearing on the 2027 budget of the Department of National Defense (DND), Sen. Erwin Tulfo asked Teodoro whether such support gives Chinese officials, like Ambassador Jing Quan, the courage to make bold remarks against the Philippines. “Would you agree with me, Sir, that China was gaining more confidence because there are some officials in this land who are […]...
